info.name: Atlassian Get Test Case Reasons (output) for Given Test Case in Step of Pipeline.

params.name: workspace
params.description: This can either be the workspace ID (slug) or the workspace UUID surrounded by curly-braces, for example `{workspace UUID}`.

params.name: test_case_uuid
params.description: The UUID of the test case.

items.docs: This API endpoint retrieves the test case reasons (output) for a specific test case within a pipeline step in Atlassian Bitbucket. It requires authentication and accepts path parameters including the workspace identifier, repository slug, pipeline UUID, step UUID, and test case UUID to uniquely identify the test case whose reasons or failure details you want to access.
